crossRefs.note: But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving…
He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that…

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Now Samuel didn’t yet know Yahweh, neither was Yahweh’s word yet revealed to him.
translations.bsb: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, because the word of the LORD had not yet been revealed to him.
translations.kjv: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, neither was the word of the LORD yet revealed unto him.
translations.asv: Now Samuel did not yet know Jehovah, neither was the word of Jehovah yet revealed unto him.
